<!-- pr-reviewer: af4e1082e98c8d5febfbb5e8296cfbdf355094d6 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blocking findings.

This is a SAFETY-tier review (P1, 2D Offset toolpath generation). I built and tested the PR head `af4e1082e` locally, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `612b47e69`. There were no conflicts.

### What looks good

- The fix closes the class, not one case. `split_band` divides each band down to 1/16 step. It examines the full-width flanks for the two cut orders (Inside and Outside). It does not only examine the swept gap.
- The two link paths have a full-width guard: `level_order::order` (the `edge_route` chord and the full `via` walk) and `ring_links::link` (`chord_full_width`). When no route passes, the code keeps the existing lift with its named note. Thus a rejected chord gives a lift, not a silent full-width cut.
- The pins are stronger than before. `fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` changes from `<= 21` to `== 0` and refuses the narrow note. `fig8_inside_offset_names_each_full_width_cut` now asserts zero off-wall points. The new `two_lobe_ring_merge_cuts_no_full_width_at_waist` runs in the default debug suite and pins Outside and Inside.
- There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The level math uses `saturating_mul`. The recursion depth has a limit of log2(16) = 4.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3788-ring-merge-waist.md` records the choices, the rejected alternatives and the provenance (Held 1991).
- No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changes, and the catalog and golden suites stay green.

### Results (locally, merged with main `612b47e69`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 180 steps, 0 failed: 98 motion suites, 79 app suites and the 2 builds. The first run stopped at the 20-minute tool limit after 153 green steps. The last 27 steps then ran with `--only`: 27 ok. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| Targeted heavy step (P1): `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start --test flute_reach -- --include-ignored` | `offset_pass_start` 21 passed, `flute_reach` 4 passed |

Extra suites run:

- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: ok (in the quick gate).
- `app suites: golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, `posting`, `verify`, `sim`: ok (in the quick gate).
- No file under `testdata/` changes, and no importer code changes. Thus the kernel STEP suites are not necessary.

### Mutations (I ran them on the review worktree, then reverted them)

1. `ring_fill::split_band`: `merge_flank_hits` returns no hits. Result: **red**. `two_lobe_ring_merge_cuts_no_full_width_at_waist` finds 146 off-wall full-width points for Outside.
2. `ring_fill::clean_walk`: the function returns its input with no change. Result: **red**. `lifts::fig8_start_sides_lift_only_with_a_named_reason` finds 3 lifts inside a level for Inside.
3. `ring_links::chord_full_width`: the function always returns `false`. Result: **red**. `two_lobe_ring_merge_cuts_no_full_width_at_waist` fails. The fig8 heavy pins stay green with this mutation. Thus the synthetic two-lobe test is the pin for this guard.

### Goldens moved

None. The PR changes no recorded program, and the body lists none.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start.rs` grows from 484 to 493 lines. The file was already more than 400 lines before this PR. A split is a P7 follow-up.
- `merge_flank_hits` calls `full_width_flanks` on each walk of each sub-band. The own-trail test in `visit_full_width` is quadratic in the sample count. The quick gate and the fig8 heavy run show no time problem. A large part with many rings can make the generation slower. A timing pin on a large part is a possible P7 follow-up.
- The PR body has two lines that are not in the template ("fork synced at v0.26.0", "Effort: max"). They do no harm.

@paulsvc, the review is clean. Please mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4014`), so that it can merge on this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - P1 (safety floor) and motion/toolpath. The review of head af4e1082e is owed; do not merge in the sweep.

Thank you for this work, and the review of head `af4e1082e` is clean. This PR is held for a decision of the maintainer, and it does not merge until he answers.

The reason: on 2026-11-25 the maintainer decided that the 2D ring planners are replaced in one step by the path kernel (#4023, record `docs/decisions/4024-path-kernel-design.md`). His rule is that no patch goes into the old planners without his word. This PR changes the old ring planner (`level_rings.rs`, `ring_links.rs`, `level_order.rs`), and it fixes a `P1` (#3788). The record says that an unsafe-output defect of the old code goes to him as a question. The main session asks him.

No change is necessary on this PR now. The label `held-for-merge` is set so that no merge sweep takes it.

Maintainer decision (question dialog, 2026-11-26): "Keep on hold". The change patches the old ring planners. The path kernel (#4023) replaces them on `side/path-kernel`. This PR stays `held-for-merge`. Its fixture is wanted as a test of the new kernel. Thank you for the work.
